2609.15820.title: AlgoEvo: Self-Evolving Agentic Search for Automated Algorithm Discovery
2609.15820.paper_summary: Large language models have advanced automated algorithm discovery by synthesizing executable code, but existing frameworks trap them in rigid search pipelines with pre-defined control flows. This limitation restricts adaptive reasoning, blocks cross-paradigm transfer, and discards valuable execution feedback. We propose AlgoEvo, a unified agentic framework that transforms automated algorithm discovery into an interactive, knowledge-accumulating process. An autonomous agent dynamically inspects, diagnoses, and edits code based on runtime feedback. A design skill hub decouples paradigm-specific knowledge from the core discovery engine, allowing a single workflow to seamlessly handle single-objective, multi-objective, and multi-component design. Meanwhile, a hierarchical experience mechanism organizes search trajectories into a task-level tree to guide exploration and consolidates cross-task patterns into reusable skills. Across six representative benchmark tasks, AlgoEvo matches or surpasses specialized methods with substantially fewer evaluations and reduced token consumption, demonstrating strong intra-task accumulation, cross-task transfer, and the ability to reproduce or exceed existing state-of-the-art performance through flexible skill activation.
2609.15820.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型透過合成可執行代碼推進了自動化算法發現，但現有框架將它們限制在具有預定控制流程的僵化搜索管道中。這一限制妨礙了自適應推理，阻礙了跨範式轉移，並丟棄了有價值的執行反饋。我們提出了AlgoEvo，一個統一的代理框架，將自動化算法發現轉變為一個互動的、知識積累的過程。一個自主代理根據運行時反饋動態檢查、診斷和編輯代碼。一個設計技能中心將範式特定知識與核心發現引擎解耦，使單一工作流程能夠無縫處理單一目標、多目標和多組件設計。與此同時，一個層次化經驗機制將搜索軌跡組織成任務級樹，以指導探索，並將跨任務模式整合為可重用的技能。在六個具有代表性的基準任務中，AlgoEvo 的評估次數顯著少於專門方法，且令牌消耗減少，展示了強大的任務內積累、跨任務轉移，以及通過靈活的技能激活重現或超越現有最先進性能的能力。
